top_signals.title: Stocks Climb as Brent Below $90 Gives Bonds a Lift: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Global stocks rose as chipmakers rebounded, with falling bond yields adding support after Brent crude slid below $90 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Machete Attacks Disrupt Congo Ebola Response
top_signals.summary:
A crowd armed with machetes chased after Ebola responders who were trying to bury a victim in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The violence is one of the latest attacks on frontline workers struggling to contain the rapidly spreading pandemic. 
Bloomberg's Chief Africa Correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.
